topics.description: Multiple sources report on the investigation into possible Iran-linked cyberattack on Minnesota water systems. The attack has affected over 30 water systems, and officials are warning about Iranian hackers.
topics.reason: Recent cyberattack on Minnesota water systems

topics.description: Several federal investigations are ongoing in Minnesota, including the cyberattack on water systems and the MyGender Dolls program investigation. Minnesota state agencies have denied involvement in the latter.
